dialogue_texts: You're the one who underestimated a humanoid. Playtime is over, so pack up your little faction and get out of my sight.
You may have bested both of us, but the Order will live on under Flandre Scarlet's rule.
Flandre? Like I'd let her run wild with whatever mess you guys cooked up. I may be paying the Scarlet Devil Mansion another visit.
The Crimsonite grunts will dance in the capital of your pathetic kingdom.
Let them dance all they want. If they bring their chaos into the Humanoid Village or the shrine, I'll just exterminate them all at once.
Berenice and I are done for...
Then stay down. You've caused enough trouble for two days.
Thank you, Your Honor. The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo at this time is safe.
Just make sure your people clean up this Crimsonite mess so I don't have to deal with it tomorrow.
I am very and truly pleased. I will attend the festival in Kozankyo.
Just don't let anyone cause another incident there. I've had more than my fill of babysitting for one night.
I am finally happy to be reunited with Fusana. With the Grieg sisters gone, their forest of thorns has disappeared.
Good for you. At least someone's getting a happy ending out of this mess. Clean up whatever roots they left behind so I don't trip over them.
They can no longer alter their fate, nor even escape and return to their own time.
That's what happens when you try to mess with things you shouldn't. Fate isn't something you can just rewrite whenever you get bored.
Using whatever time we have left, I can finally show you what our nights are like in the mansion.
As I remark on the romance between myself and Fusana, our private ball begins now.
